substitutions.name: 3-ton aluminium low-profile floor jack
substitutions.intro: Arcan A20019 is the 3-ton aluminium low-profile floor jack. 3 US ton / 6000 lb lifting capacity. 3.75–18 inch lift range.
substitutions.advice: Use only on a suitable hard, level surface at approved lifting points. Immediately support the vehicle with appropriately selected stands; never work underneath a vehicle supported only by this jack.
substitutions.verificationNote: Current A20019 selected explicitly, replacing A20018. Manufacturer page BUY ON AMAZON points directly to B0047D2FWM; title/model and 732425000258 UPC match.

substitutions.name: Dominator clear-lens safety glasses
substitutions.intro: DEWALT DPG94-1D is the dominator clear-lens safety glasses. Clear-lens DPG94-1D industrial variant. Full-frame design.
substitutions.advice: Clear lenses preserve visibility indoors. Match eye protection to the task; safety glasses alone do not cover every grinding, chemical-splash or face-protection requirement.
substitutions.verificationNote: Explicit industrial DPG94-1D substitution, not relabelling DPG94-1C. Manufacturer industrial catalogue identifies clear 1D; direct Amazon page confirms DPG94-1D, one item and clear lens.
